items.title: Strategy's Bitcoin Pile Nears June Record After $76M Purchase
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm’s holdings bottomed at 840,447 BTC in August.

items.title: Strategy buys 950 Bitcoin for $76M, repurchases $174M in STRC
items.summary: Strategy bought 950 Bitcoin for $75.7 million after a two-week pause and spent another $174 million repurchasing its STRC preferred stock.

items.title: Google and Apple seek crypto talent as Big Tech eyes stablecoin and tokenization rails
items.summary: The tech giants’ job listings could indicate that they are separately pursuing experts in stablecoins and tokenized deposits for future projects.

items.title: ‘A little more orange’: Strategy buys 950 bitcoin for $76 million, bringing total holdings to 846,000 BTC
items.summary: Strategy's total holdings account for around 4% of the 21 million bitcoin supply cap — worth roughly $72 billion.
